subject: gov.policy
name: National artificial-intelligence strategy
what_would_settle_it: The strategy document, or the Council of Ministers communique or ministerial statement adopting it; a July 2026 report refers to a national strategy engaged by the government and the base holds no instrument, date, scope or budget

subject: gov.legislate
name: Text of the spectrum-royalty amendment
what_would_settle_it: The gazetted decree with its number and the amended rate table; the regulator's site carries no 2026 royalties text and the rates reach the wiki only through a Council of Ministers communique

subject: finance.budget
name: Domestic state appropriation to digital technology
what_would_settle_it: The finance law for 2026 or the finance ministry's budget annexes showing the appropriation to the digital ministry and the identity, cybersecurity, regulatory and digital agencies; the compiled budget outputs hold no Togo file

subject: infra.connect
name: Internet shutdown or throttling in 2025
what_would_settle_it: A network-measurement or shutdown-tracker country entry with dates and duration; the continental table the base holds names the event in two words

subject: infra.connect
name: Mobile network population coverage
what_would_settle_it: The regulator's annual market observatory or quarterly statistical bulletin, the equivalent of the series the base already holds in full for Nigeria

subject: infra.connect
name: National 5G strategy
what_would_settle_it: A digital economy ministry or regulator strategy document; the regional regulators' association positively records that none is published, so this may close as a stated absence

subject: infra.cybersec
name: Incident response team operational record
what_would_settle_it: An incident-response profile of the kind the base holds for Rwanda and Ghana, an annual incident report, or a membership record with an international response network; the 333,000-incident total is a single news attribution with no breakdown

subject: dpi.id
name: Data-protection authority's authorisation for biometric and identification-number processing
what_would_settle_it: The authority's published register of authorisations, or the authorisation decision itself for the identity agency's processing; article 8 of the 2019 statute requires prior authorisation both for biometric data and for use of a national identification number, and the authority's own organisational decree is also unheld

subject: dpi.id
name: National citizen account or single sign-on
what_would_settle_it: Technical or service documentation for the public-services portal, or any statement on which agency systems federate to the identification number; the volunteering agency's new mobile application is the immediate test case

subject: tech.ai
name: The data-collection start-up named as the flagship project's partner
what_would_settle_it: A company filing, an agency or association member listing, or a founder profile establishing founding date, size and funding

subject: tech.industry
name: Declaration issued at the Lome space forum
what_would_settle_it: The declaration text as issued at the close of the forum on 31 July 2026, or its publication by the organisers or the regulator

subject: tech.industry
name: Digital sector share of gross domestic product
what_would_settle_it: A national accounts series or ministry statistical annex; the base holds a government figure of about 4 per cent for 2022 against a stated target of 10 per cent, relayed by trade press with no target date and nothing measured since

subject: tech.innovate
name: Start-up statute or legal framework
what_would_settle_it: A law or decree on start-up labelling and incentives, or a ministerial statement that none exists; the industry association's own remedy for legal uncertainty was a private law-firm partnership

subject: include.divides
name: Gender-disaggregated digital access measure
what_would_settle_it: A sex-disaggregated figure from an international telecommunications or financial-inclusion series, or the national statistics institute's own household survey; the only gender figure in the section is a 2020 programme statistic carried by a 2023 reference study

subject: include.divides
name: Rural and urban connectivity gap measure
what_would_settle_it: A regulator coverage or penetration series broken down by region or by rural and urban area; the base holds only a sub-Saharan regional figure and Togo's rural population share

subject: include.divides
name: Universal service fund
what_would_settle_it: The fund's constituting instrument and any published annual report or regulator accounts showing its balance, governance body and disbursements; the only held reference is the article of the fee decree allocating 30 per cent of fine proceeds to it

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Gulf-state digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any investment, data-centre agreement or sovereign-fund commitment naming Togo; the subject returns no Togolese source at all

subject: geopol.india
name: Indian digital or technology cooperation instrument
what_would_settle_it: Any memorandum, credit line, training-programme participation or supplier contract naming Togo; the subject returns no Togolese source

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 2017-006 d'orientation sur la societe de l'information
what_would_settle_it: The statute's own text or a gazette reference; it is known only from another decree's visas

subject: gov.legislate
name: Loi n 2017-007 relative aux transactions electroniques
what_would_settle_it: The statute's own text or a gazette reference; it is known only from another decree's visas

subject: gov.protect
name: Data localisation requirement
what_would_settle_it: An enacted localisation obligation, or a dated regulator statement that the objective has been dropped

subject: include.access
name: Accessibility of digital public services for persons with disabilities
what_would_settle_it: An accessibility standard or requirement binding on government digital services, or the operative text of the 2004 disability statute and its revision
